title: 2-SAT Dimer Problem (A,B,C and D,E,F channels)
description: A 2-SAT problem encoded as a dimer patchy-particle system with two independent conditions. Condition B (TF) allows only 1 false (A) monomer at a time - if A,A are attached simultaneously, one (higher ID) flips to C. Condition D (TT) requires both to be true - if even one false (E) attaches, it switches to F. The solution is B=True, which satisfies both conditions.

proposal_context.motivation: Tests non-equilibrium driven computation with two independent logical conditions. Each condition is encoded as a dimer system with state-changing patches that implement the logical rules.

measurement_perturbation_relaxation.measurement: Detect A,A on both B faces, or E on D faces
measurement_perturbation_relaxation.perturbation: Flip A→C (higher ID) or E→F based on policy

encoding.geometry_description: Two independent channels: A,B,C (core type 1) and D,E,F (core type 12). Each monomer has 1 core + 3 patches. B and D have two patch faces (face1 and face2).

species.label: core_ABC
species.description: Core atom for A,B,C channel (excluded volume)

species.label: A
species.description: A-patch (false, switchable, can flip to C)

species.label: core_EDF
species.description: Core atom for D,E,F channel (excluded volume)

species.label: E
species.description: E-patch (false, switchable, can flip to F)

interactions.description: Channel ABC: A/C attract to B faces (types 3,5). Channel EFD: E/F attract to D faces (types 9,11). Channels are independent (no cross-interactions).

target.description: Concentration of true particles (C and F) at end of simulation

decoding.success_criteria: Reach ≥70% combined C+F concentration before timeout

design_freedom.description: Participants design the state-change policy (when/how to flip A→C and E→F) and can tune interaction parameters. The molecular encoding (species, geometry, initial composition) is fixed by the problem.

scoring.description: Maximize concentration of true particles (C and F) at end of simulation. Higher is better.

secondary_metrics.name: total_state_changes
secondary_metrics.description: Total number of A→C and E→F flip events

secondary_metrics.name: time_to_solution
secondary_metrics.description: Timesteps required to reach 70% true particle concentration

secondary_metrics.name: cumulative_work
secondary_metrics.description: Sum of ΔPE between thermo outputs

penalties.description: Simulation timeout (no additional penalty, just stop)
Penalize solutions with very low true particle concentration

allowed_transitions.description: Channel 1: A→C when A,A on both B faces (flip higher ID)
allowed_transitions.trigger_condition: A,A attached to B on both faces simultaneously

allowed_transitions.description: Channel 2: E→F when E attaches to D (any face)
allowed_transitions.trigger_condition: E attached to D (even one face)

forbidden_transitions: B → anything (B is condition monomer, must stay B)
D → anything (D is condition monomer, must stay D)

tunable_parameters.name: morse_depth
tunable_parameters.description: Morse potential depth for all attractive pairs

tunable_parameters.name: morse_alpha
tunable_parameters.physical_meaning: How sharply attraction falls off with distance

tunable_parameters.name: morse_r0
tunable_parameters.physical_meaning: Preferred binding distance (0 = patches can overlap)

tunable_parameters.name: contact_cutoff
tunable_parameters.description: Distance threshold for state change trigger
tunable_parameters.physical_meaning: How close patches must be to trigger flip

correctness_checks.description: Each molecule has 1 core + 3 patches (A,C,E,F) or 1 core + 6 patches (B,D)
All B and D molecules must remain unchanged (condition monomers invariant)
No sudden energy spikes (indicates numerical instability)

condition_B.description: Allows only 1 false (A) monomer to be attached at a time. If A,A are attached simultaneously to B on both faces, one (higher ID) flips to C (true). If C,C or A,C are attached, nothing happens.

monomers.B: condition monomer with two patch faces

condition_D.description: Both need to be true (F). If even one false (E) attaches to D, it switches to type F (true).

monomers.D: condition monomer with two patch faces

problem_structure.independence: The two sets A,B,C and D,E,F are independent and do not interact with each other.
problem_structure.solution: If we set B to True (ON), both rules are satisfied: (Anything ∨ True) = True for both conditions.

greedy_policy.description: Always flip A→C when A,A on both B faces, E→F when E on D
